cover_letter.greeting: Dear AWS Commercial Regions Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, Scaling Regions role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I follow data center and cloud infrastructure finance closely, and I like that this role owns the numbers for regions in their scaling phase, where results shape where AWS invests next.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation that I turned into recommendations for stakeholders. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, which is the closest thing I've done to owning a regional P&L.

That lines up with the monthly financial review, the OP2 plan and explaining what moved and why. I'm comfortable with large data sets and with automating reporting so the team spends more time on the story behind the numbers. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, Scaling Regions role in AWS Commercial Regions Finance. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. I'd like to hear how the team works with the EMEA and APAC expansion leaders. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
